issue.title: Guides for starting a monitor and reviewing a sudo request
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1le.20.1.19 (automation-edit, epic sase-1le.20.1) in notes
#2 and #3 as "guide candidate" follow-ups under the docs edit checklist.

Add two task-oriented Guide pages that teach first-run flows the Reference only names:

1. Start a monitor and act on its follow-up. `docs/reference/automation/monitors.md`
   documents the monitor contract; no Guide walks a reader through starting one and
   handling the follow-up turn.
2. Review and approve a sudo request. `docs/reference/automation/sudo.md` documents the
   sudo gate contract; no Guide walks a reader through reviewing and approving a request.

Each guide should follow `docs/contribute/writing-docs.md` (Guide tier, one goal per
page, facts linked from the Reference rather than restated) and join the Guides nav.
